verdict.rationale: Lago is a billing platform rather than a coding agent, so publishing an MCP server is a fair question here. Lago documents an official MCP server, written in Rust, that gives AI assistants like Claude direct access to its billing data. A probe confirmed the dedicated docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works, and evidence of which tools it exposes, whether it supports write actions, and how setup and authentication work.
